correctness.rationale: The exact reduction to a compatibility clique problem is proved by left normalization; the verifier builds all candidates and edges from definitions, uses a proper-coloring upper bound in exhaustive branch-and-bound, and returns M(3..6)=3,8,13,48. A second exhaustive Bron--Kerbosch routine certifies 26 normalized S5 maxima, 240 labeled maxima, and one left-right orbit; the displayed witness is checked pairwise.

originality.rationale: Targeted literature-index and web searches for the exact values, agreement-parity synonyms, graph equivalences, and the 240-family orbit statement found no equal or stronger result. The closest source arXiv:2609.21645v1 publicly states only general bounds/constructions in the accessible material. The conclusion is best-of-knowledge, with residual risk from unavailable section-level full-text comparison explicitly recorded.

value.rationale: The exact finite window supplies concrete benchmarks for the new permutation-Eventown problem, proves sharpness of the even-order construction at n=4 and n=6, resolves the first nontrivial odd case n=5, and adds a complete labeled count and symmetry classification at that order.
